title: 2.7 Modes of Disease Transmission and Prevention
description: How pathogens spread, the chain of infection and the main prevention measures. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Pathogen?
options: Transmission through physical touching between people
The time between infection and the start of symptoms
The provision of clean water and safe waste disposal
A microorganism capable of causing disease in a host
questions.correctAnswer: A microorganism capable of causing disease in a host

questions.question: What is Infectious disease?
options: Separation of people who may have been exposed to a pathogen
The administration of a vaccine to produce protective immunity
Separation of people who are already infected with a disease
A disease caused by a pathogen that can spread between hosts
questions.correctAnswer: A disease caused by a pathogen that can spread between hosts

questions.question: What is Transmission?
options: An organism that carries a pathogen between hosts
The time between infection and the start of symptoms
A microorganism capable of causing disease in a host
The spread of a pathogen from one host to another
questions.correctAnswer: The spread of a pathogen from one host to another

questions.question: What is Direct contact?
options: Cleaning hands to remove pathogens and prevent spread
The complete removal or killing of all microbial life
Transmission through physical touching between people
Spread via tiny particles that remain suspended in air
questions.correctAnswer: Transmission through physical touching between people

questions.question: What is Droplet transmission?
options: Clothing or equipment worn to reduce exposure to pathogens
The time during which an infected person can spread disease
Spread through respiratory droplets from coughs or sneezes
A disease caused by a pathogen that can spread between hosts
questions.correctAnswer: Spread through respiratory droplets from coughs or sneezes

questions.question: What is Airborne transmission?
options: An inanimate object that carries and transfers pathogens
Spread via tiny particles that remain suspended in air
The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces
Protection of a population when many people are immune
questions.correctAnswer: Spread via tiny particles that remain suspended in air
